channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Nigeria rolls out locally made armoured carriers as army ramps up defence capabilities
item.description: The Nigerian Army has taken delivery of a new batch of armoured personnel carriers, combining locally manufactured platforms with foreign-supplied vehicles, in a move that underscores the country’s growing ambitions in defence production and its continued reliance on international partnerships

item.title: Algeria clears $30million hurdle for Australian miner Terramin to advance $471million zinc project
item.description: Australia’s Terramin has launched site works at Algeria’s Tala Hamza zinc project after a $30million land acquisition cleared delays, as the country seeks to boost mining and cut reliance on hydrocarbons

item.title: Africa’s 10 most polluted nations: Insights from the World Air Quality report
item.description: Air pollution continues to pose a major health and environmental challenge across Africa, with fine particulate matter, known as PM2

item.title: Nigeria signs digital deal with Finland as Europe backs Africa’s tech talent push with €23million funding
item.description: Nigeria and Finland have signed a digital cooperation agreement as the EU rolls out a €23m initiative to boost public services and train tech talent in Africa’s largest economy

item.title: Niger and Algeria continue to ease up on their cold war with fresh agreements
item.description: Niger and Algeria are deepening their strategic collaboration with a new wave of agreements aimed at accelerating development in key sectors, marking a significant step forward in West and North African regional cooperation

item.title: Natie Kirsh becomes Africa’s 3rd richest person as his $5.29b surge tops Rabiu’s $4.47b
item.description: Following reports regarding a $29 billion divestment by Natie Kirsh, the South African billionaire has ascended to the position of the third-wealthiest individual in Africa, surpassing Nigerias Abdulsamad Rabiu

item.title: Morocco has just over 50 days of diesel and petrol reserves amid Middle East conflict
item.description: Morocco has enough diesel and petrol reserves to last 51 and 55 days, with coal and gas supplies secured through June

item.title: Dangote refinery counters reports of higher crude allocation from Nigerian government
item.description: Confusion has emerged over crude supply allocations to the Dangote Petroleum Refinery, with officials at the facility saying they are unaware of any increase in cargoes reportedly approved by the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC)

item.title: Ibrahim Traoré rejects democracy as violence surges across Burkina Faso
item.description: Burkina Faso’s leader Ibrahim Traoré rejects democracy, dissolves political parties, and delays elections as insecurity worsens and regional alliances shift across the Sahel

item.title: Trump moves to reshape US–Africa policy with top nomination
item.description: Frank Garcia, Donald Trump’s pick for Assistant Secretary of State for African Affairs, could reshape US–Africa relations, prioritising trade and investment over traditional aid programs

item.title: Africa's wealthiest king leads $750 million investment to boost gold production by 134% across 5 African countries
item.description: Morocco’s Managem Group, owned by Al Mada, the royal family’s office under King Mohammed VI, Africa’s wealthiest monarch, has committed $750 million to increase its gold production by 134% across its mining operations in Africa by 2030

item.title: US eyes Morocco for strategic drone hub as Africa security push deepens
item.description: The US plans a drone training centre in Morocco to boost Africa’s security capabilities, leveraging African Lion 2026 and advanced military technology partnerships

item.title: Ghana and Zimbabwe sign 10 deals to reboot trade ties
item.description: Ghana and Zimbabwe have signed 10 cooperation agreements covering energy, trade, and tourism, as both countries seek to boost low bilateral trade and attract investment
